correctness.rationale: For 1≤n≤6, disjoint-shadow codebooks and hitting sets of equal size certify both optima by weak duality. At n=7, rational primal and dual vectors both sum to 9 and satisfy every inequality, so U_7=9. Independently regenerated the words and shadows with integer masks and checked every supplied certificate, including all eight confusability cliques. Distinct words conflict iff each word has at most one 1 outside the other: their bitwise intersection then belongs to both shadows. Counting every compatible subset once in increasing mask order gave counts by size 0 through 8 of 1,34,401,2068,4860,5004,2048,282,10, with none larger. This independently proves M_7=8 and precisely ten labeled maximizing codebooks. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/replay145.py (FIB lines); output /workspace/branches/replay145.txt.
residual_risks: No claim beyond lengths 1 to 7 or about a different error channel or polytope is certified.
